Success criteria: The right gripper must be closed during pressing and make actual contact in the top region near the bell's central button. Merely aligning or hovering above it does not count.

## Execution tips

- Consider aligning the closed gripper's fingertip with the center of the pale-orange round button and touching down gently in small increments from above. Adjust based on actual fingertip position to avoid aligning the gripper midpoint while the fingertip lands on the housing edge.
